text:
ravi: Hey team — running the Node quickstart (sdk v2) after terraform auto-provisions an org+workspace. Console shows payment method attached but the very first SDK request returns 402. Anyone hit a flow like this?
lana: Did the console show any banners on the org or billing page? sometimes theres a followup activation step.
ravi: Console looks normal, no errors visible. SDK error:
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{
  "error": "billing_activation_required",
  "message": "Activate billing contact before API access is allowed. Go to Console > Billing or call the activation API."
}
```
devex: This is new-ish: infra-created orgs are placed into a PENDING_ACTIVATION state by default to avoid accidental charges. Its separate from adding a card. We should have updated the quickstart note.
ravi: Can this be done from CI (no manual click)?
devex: Yes — infra flows can POST to the activation endpoint. Example (requires an org-admin token):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.inference/api/v1/orgs/<ORG_ID>/billing/activate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"contact_email":"infra+ci@example.com", "contact_name":"Infra CI", "accepted_terms":true}'
```
lana: Nice. Could add a small `null_resource` + `local-exec` step to the terraform example to POST that after org creation.
devex: Agreed. Followups: (1) add a terraform post-create snippet to quickstart, (2) issue for provider to support an explicit `auto_activate_billing_for_tests` flag (sandbox-only), (3) SDK change to map `billing_activation_required` into a friendlier error with a link to Console > Billing and the activation API.
sdk-bot: Note: current SDK surfaces 402 as a thrown error. We can add client-side hint text and a togglable automatic retry-with-delay for activation transitions, but need to avoid masking legitimate billing issues.
ravi: Implemented the local-exec workaround, re-ran the quickstart smoke test and the SDK call now returns 200. Documenting the workaround in our infra repo and will open a PR to quickstart. :tada:
billing-bot: Billing state for org <ORG_ID>: PENDING_ACTIVATION. No invoices issued. To enable API access: activate billing via Console or the activation API. For automation requests beyond sandbox, contact billing-team@redwood.com.
lana: Thanks for the debug, ravi. devex please add the quickstart note and sample local-exec. Also update the SDK error docs so customers see an actionable message instead of a raw 402.
devex: On it — filing the docs PR and an SDK issue. Leaving this thread as the record for the workaround and followups.
ravi: thanks all!
